it rendered, what it logged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements
- [Create a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Availab
le only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A ses
sion is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its Ap
p in one local Chromium context.…
- [Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.md): Available
only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A sessi
on is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an accessibility tree and addr
essable elements without replay…
- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the l
ocal Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to
the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one coordinate action with fresh project/server
authorization.
- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on t
he local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is boun
d to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the
same locator vocabul…
- [Close a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/close-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available
only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A sessi
on is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser.
Returns closed=false if no mat…
- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entr
y per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many r
uns were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshot
s. Send a `revisionNumber` back…
- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-
a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.
- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this
server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts.
Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.
- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or nam
e. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `detai
ls.code: "account_name_ambiguous"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.
- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md):
Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unkno
wn id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.
- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account
and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also inv
alidates any copy of the same token you hold.
- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-o
r-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the
server uses answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_taken"`.
- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{p
rojectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed on
e when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Su
nse…
- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The repositor
ies in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices
a connect has).
- [Run an eval suite on a repository's pull requests](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositor
ys-pull-requests.md): Connect a repository so every pull request to it runs one eval suite and reports a GitHub check. **Affects e
veryone who opens a pull request on that repository**, and with `outagePolicy: fail_closed` it can block their merges.
- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credit
s are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` r
equest ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spe
nds.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.
- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organi
zation and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Gue
st callers are denied.
- [Delete a project and everything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/delete-a-project-and-everything-sc
oped-to-it.md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace and its memberships, every
saved server in the project (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs that referenced it), and hosted
tasks. Requires project admin. The request body must be…
